is deterministic, ordered and byte-identical for every participant

a fresh service reconciles a published revision terminal without replaying start effects

authenticates before parsing and keeps loopback CSRF separate from session auth

portable lock validation is recursive and rejects private/absolute canaries
validates a strict bounded manifest and derives its normative digest

validates file integrity and parser provenance
upgrades an existing broad context ignore without clobbering it

section_dispositions.heading: AI-first Home and CLI Capability Fabric design
section_dispositions.rationale: Top-level product contract is exercised through the real Home, shared capability action domain, and durable revision-start owner.

section_dispositions.heading: Decision
section_dispositions.rationale: The selected AI-first Home, capability runtime, and compatibility CLI are exercised at their real boundaries.

section_dispositions.heading: Why this change is necessary
section_dispositions.rationale: Durable continuity and host-owned extension behavior are covered by real runtime proofs.

section_dispositions.heading: Goals
section_dispositions.rationale: The product goals map to executable Home, context delivery, action-domain, and broker proofs.

section_dispositions.heading: Non-goals
section_dispositions.rationale: The absence of a generic plugin dashboard and the host-owned broker boundary are exercised by the selected behavior.

section_dispositions.heading: Product and authority principles
section_dispositions.rationale: Shared authority, immutable review, process-bound revision ownership, and host-owned effects are exercised across all three domains.

section_dispositions.heading: System architecture
section_dispositions.rationale: Each architecture boundary has a real reader, delivery, action-domain, or broker proof.

section_dispositions.heading: Subsystem 1: AI-first Conversation Home
section_dispositions.rationale: The Home subsystem is exercised through the real browser interaction.

section_dispositions.heading: Information architecture
section_dispositions.rationale: The rail, timeline, composer, and inline controls are exercised in the real Home.

section_dispositions.heading: Durable session catalog
section_dispositions.rationale: Catalog rebuild, lineage, cursor, and browser restore semantics have exact behavioral proofs.

section_dispositions.heading: Safe session switching
section_dispositions.rationale: Unit and browser races prove activation-bound cancellation, authoritative-head restart, and late-page rejection.

section_dispositions.heading: Durable user-message admission queue
section_dispositions.rationale: The durable queue proof exercises fsynced idempotent admission, restart recovery, and causal FIFO delivery.

section_dispositions.heading: Natural language and friendly actions
section_dispositions.rationale: Friendly controls route through the real reviewed action authority.

section_dispositions.heading: Action lifecycle in the UI
section_dispositions.rationale: Review, exact streamed operation folding, terminal presentation, and draft-preserving failure are exercised through real authorities.

section_dispositions.heading: Visual production standard
section_dispositions.rationale: The production Home, mobile/200% reflow, and automated accessibility browser oracles cover rendered standards.

section_dispositions.heading: Accessibility contract
section_dispositions.rationale: Browser accessibility, focus restoration, zoom-safe controls, draft preservation, and activation tests exercise this contract.

section_dispositions.heading: Conversation authority and context continuity
section_dispositions.rationale: The context and revision authority umbrella is bound to exact delivery, ownership, terminal-mirroring, and fresh-replay proofs.

section_dispositions.heading: Generalized child revisions
section_dispositions.rationale: Child reservation, durable start ownership, exact terminal recovery, failed-operation idempotency, lineage head, and action WAL behavior are executable.

section_dispositions.heading: Canonical context handoff
section_dispositions.rationale: Canonical shared handoff and exact self-excluding turn deltas are directly exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: Same-revision structured turn delivery
section_dispositions.rationale: Receipt-bound public deltas and target-only private file delivery are directly exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: Reactions and multi-source quotes
section_dispositions.rationale: Authority fold, UI selection, and real browser request/response are all exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: Action proposal model
section_dispositions.rationale: Immutable proposal and commit behavior is exercised by shared action and revision authorities.

section_dispositions.heading: Actor, policy, grant, and approval authority
section_dispositions.rationale: Actor approval, capability authority, and minimal permission proofs bind this section.

section_dispositions.heading: Public API
section_dispositions.rationale: Authenticated HTTP, capability action routes, and the real browser client exercise public API behavior.

section_dispositions.heading: Cross-domain outbox and reconciliation
section_dispositions.rationale: Cross-domain commit, publication recovery, and revision authority are executable.

section_dispositions.heading: Public/private boundary
section_dispositions.rationale: Public scanning, target-only and browser-memory-only one-shot private delivery, no-echo CLI, and scrubbed broker projections are exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: Subsystem 2: CLI Capability Fabric
section_dispositions.rationale: The capability subsystem is exercised through its real action domain and CLI routing.

section_dispositions.heading: Package model
section_dispositions.rationale: Manifest, source resolution, immutable planning, and exact graph preimages cover package behavior.

section_dispositions.heading: Three durable sources of truth
section_dispositions.rationale: Authority, portable lock, and WAL publication proofs cover all durable sources.

section_dispositions.heading: Adapter contract
section_dispositions.rationale: Inspection, graph closure, production broker, and effect receipts exercise the adapter contract.

section_dispositions.heading: Existing implementation to reuse
section_dispositions.rationale: Reused canonicalization, framing, and action authority paths are directly tested.

section_dispositions.heading: Permission model
section_dispositions.rationale: Minimal union, authority activation, and commit-bound revalidation cover permission behavior.

section_dispositions.heading: Install lifecycle
section_dispositions.rationale: Real proposal, zero-write inspection, WAL commit, and broker effect behavior cover installation.

section_dispositions.heading: Update, remove, rollback, repair, and status
section_dispositions.rationale: Recovery/rollback publication, durable storage, and command routing exercise lifecycle mutations.

section_dispositions.heading: Friendly CLI surface
section_dispositions.rationale: Parser, routing, private-input no-echo, exact automation grants, cold zero-effect dry-run, and all request-file forms cover the CLI surface.

section_dispositions.heading: shared non-TTY direct-mode suffix
section_dispositions.rationale: The direct-mode grammar, exact live automation proof, and zero-effect dry-run are executable.

section_dispositions.heading: request-file mode is the exclusive alternative; its DTO owns the key (authority repair excluded)
section_dispositions.rationale: Exclusive request-file parsing, routing, all nine DTO forms, exact automation proof, and zero-write refusal are directly exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: Migration and cutover
section_dispositions.rationale: Reader compatibility, shared authority, and Home cutover are exercised by final-state behavior.

section_dispositions.heading: Phase 1: characterization and reader compatibility
section_dispositions.rationale: Reader behavior and durable framing are characterized by exact tests.

section_dispositions.heading: Phase 2: derived catalog and shared action authority
section_dispositions.rationale: Derived reads and shared action authority are directly exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: Phase 3: revision continuity and Capability Fabric
section_dispositions.rationale: Revision continuity and the full capability authority/runtime surface have executable proofs.

section_dispositions.heading: Phase 4: AI Home cutover
section_dispositions.rationale: Unit and browser Home acceptance proofs cover the cutover.

section_dispositions.heading: Phase 5: delete duplicate implementations
section_dispositions.rationale: Single routing, Home, and action-domain behavior prove the surviving paths.

section_dispositions.heading: Normative wire and storage contract
section_dispositions.rationale: Canonical digest, framing, and portable storage validators exercise the wire/storage umbrella.

section_dispositions.heading: Canonical values and bounds
section_dispositions.rationale: Canonical value, bounded manifest, and public projection validators exercise exact bounds.

section_dispositions.heading: Handoff wire contract
section_dispositions.rationale: Shared handoff, exact turn delta, and target-only private delivery cover the wire contract.

section_dispositions.heading: Action enums and preview
section_dispositions.rationale: Action authority, safe preview projection, real domain routes, and revision actions exercise enum arms.

section_dispositions.heading: Proposal and operation wire bodies
section_dispositions.rationale: Proposal validation, real action-domain transport, and WAL operation publication cover body schemas.

section_dispositions.heading: Action, approval, and challenge authority records
section_dispositions.rationale: Exact approval/WAL tamper and real route commit proofs exercise authority records.

section_dispositions.heading: Authoritative capability records
section_dispositions.rationale: All authoritative capability record families have concrete validators and runtime proofs.

section_dispositions.heading: Lineage, revision-start, and grant authority records
section_dispositions.rationale: Lineage, process-bound revision ownership, exact terminal mirroring, delivery receipt, grant, and action authority records are exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: HTTP errors and status mapping
section_dispositions.rationale: Server status mapping, capability HTTP routes, and browser error preservation are executable.

section_dispositions.heading: CLI JSON and exit contract
section_dispositions.rationale: Parser, routing, JSON no-echo, and noninteractive exit behavior are directly tested.

section_dispositions.heading: Storage framing and permissions
section_dispositions.rationale: VFFR, portable storage, permission witness, and durable operation receipts cover storage.

section_dispositions.heading: Error and recovery contract
section_dispositions.rationale: Each durable domain has tamper, owner-loss, mirror-failure, idempotent terminal, or crash-recovery behavior under test.

section_dispositions.heading: Security requirements
section_dispositions.rationale: Secret projection, authentication, portable storage, graph substitution, and CLI no-echo are exercised.

section_dispositions.heading: Verification strategy
section_dispositions.rationale: The strategy umbrella references executable proofs across every work unit and the pinned server runtime.

section_dispositions.heading: Characterization tests
section_dispositions.rationale: Legacy reader and compatibility routing behavior is characterized.

section_dispositions.heading: Unit and property tests
section_dispositions.rationale: The explicit catalog binds unit/property oracles across every implementation domain.

section_dispositions.heading: Integration and fault-injection tests
section_dispositions.rationale: Crash, race, owner-loss, terminal-mirror, cold zero-effect dry-run, restart, route, and real browser integration proofs are selected.

section_dispositions.heading: Owned CLI process lifecycle and orphan recovery
section_dispositions.rationale: The owned-process proof binds Windows Job Object containment before receipt publication and untrusted CLI launch.

section_dispositions.heading: UI and end-to-end tests
section_dispositions.rationale: Home unit races and real Chromium acceptance/accessibility proofs cover UI behavior.

section_dispositions.heading: Migration and release rehearsal
section_dispositions.rationale: Reader compatibility, CLI compatibility, browser restore, restart publication, and pinned Bun server behavior cover rehearsal.

section_dispositions.heading: Whole-repository gate
section_dispositions.rationale: Representative exact proofs from every unit and the pinned Bun server runtime are re-executed in the same verify invocation.

section_dispositions.heading: Implementation boundaries and sequencing
section_dispositions.rationale: The final owned boundaries are exercised after sequencing converges.

section_dispositions.heading: Alternatives considered
section_dispositions.rationale: The chosen Home and broker behavior supply evidence for the rejected umbrella alternatives.

section_dispositions.heading: General plugin UI platform
section_dispositions.rationale: The inline Home and host broker prove the selected alternative.

section_dispositions.heading: MCP for every capability
section_dispositions.rationale: Broker outcome classification and the shared action domain exercise the narrower integration choice.

section_dispositions.heading: Independent installers behind chat cards
section_dispositions.rationale: Shared action authority, WAL publication, and inline UI prove the non-independent installer model.

section_dispositions.heading: In-place participant mutation or retained native sessions
section_dispositions.rationale: Child revision authority and exact resumed delta exercise the selected continuity model.

section_dispositions.heading: In-memory session list or journal fold on every request
section_dispositions.rationale: Derived catalog, stable inventory, and bounded timeline prove the durable read model.

section_dispositions.heading: Big-bang cutover or permanent dual implementation
section_dispositions.rationale: Single CLI routing, Home, and action-domain paths prove the final cutover.

section_dispositions.heading: Completion criteria
section_dispositions.rationale: Completion is bound to the complete explicit proof catalog across all product units and the pinned Bun server runtime.
